# Copilot instructions

This repository's agent guide is [`.claude/CLAUDE.md`](../.claude/CLAUDE.md). Read it first and
follow it. It is the single source for architecture, conventions and the rules the codebase
holds to ([ADR-0001](../docs/adr/0001-claude-code-as-canonical-agent-harness.md)).

Gates you must keep green are listed in [`docs/guides/harness.md`](../docs/guides/harness.md).
